title: Ticket Terms: Deposits, Payment and Tenders — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
These are the money terms of a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket in each service class: the deposit, when the balance falls due, the tenders accepted, whether Finch Circle alteration credit can pay the class's operation charges, and what an ended or altered garment costs or keeps.

## Deposit terms

| Service class | Deposit taken at drop-off, percent of the quoted total | Minimum deposit when a deposit is taken (USD) | Deposit refunded when the ticket is cancelled before work starts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Express Hem & Cuff | 0 | not applicable | yes |
| Standard Alterations | 0 | not applicable | yes |
| Tailored Suiting | 0 | not applicable | yes |
| Formal & Evening Wear | 50 | 50.00 | yes |
| Bridal Alterations | 50 | 100.00 | yes |
| Leather & Specialty | 50 | 50.00 | yes |

## Payment and tender terms

| Term | Express Hem & Cuff | Standard Alterations | Tailored Suiting | Formal & Evening Wear | Bridal Alterations | Leather & Specialty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| When the balance is due | at pickup | at pickup | at pickup | at pickup | at pickup | at pickup |
| Finch Circle alteration credit can pay the class's operation charges | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Charged when a ticket is ended after work began | completed operations at the price list | completed operations at the price list | completed operations at the price list | completed operations at the price list | completed operations at the price list | completed operations at the price list |
| Altered merchandise can still be returned for a refund | no | no | no | no | no | no |

Tenders accepted for alteration charges are the same in all six classes: a Marlowe & Finch card (the Marlowe & Finch store card or Marlowe & Finch Mastercard), another bank's credit card, a debit card, cash at the store counter, a Marlowe & Finch gift card, and Finch Circle alteration credit.

## Points of reading

- Only Formal & Evening Wear, Bridal Alterations and Leather & Specialty carry a deposit percentage above 0; in the other three classes no deposit is taken and the minimum does not apply.
- The minimum is a floor on a deposit that is taken: 50.00 USD in Formal & Evening Wear and Leather & Specialty, 100.00 USD in Bridal Alterations.
- Leather & Specialty is the one class whose operation charges cannot be paid with Finch Circle alteration credit.
- Hypothetical illustration: a garment altered in any class cannot afterwards be returned for a refund, because every class shows "no" for altered merchandise.
